questions.question: Most of my diabetic patients come in with a foot ulcer that is already infected. Can we pick up pre-ulcer changes in the OPD, before the skin breaks?
questions.population: Type 2 diabetes for 10+ years, many with neuropathy, mostly working-age men from peri-urban areas

questions.author: Dr. Arjun Menon
questions.question: Heart failure patients I discharge are readmitted within 30 days with fluid overload. Is there a home signal we can watch a week before decompensation?
questions.population: HFrEF after an index admission, older adults, family caregiver at home

questions.author: Dr. Sneha Patil
questions.question: We estimate blood loss after delivery by eye and I think we under-read PPH. Would measured blood loss change when we escalate?
questions.population: Vaginal deliveries at a mid-size private maternity unit

questions.author: Dr. Farah Siddiqui
questions.question: Anaemia is common among the adolescent girls we see at school camps. Is there a needle-free way to screen haemoglobin quickly on site?
questions.population: Girls aged 11–17 at government schools, screened at quarterly camps

questions.author: Dr. Rahul Deshmukh
questions.question: Blood pressure stays uncontrolled at follow-up even on two or three drugs. Is the problem adherence or slow titration, and can a home protocol fix it?
questions.population: Hypertension, 40–70 years, many also diabetic, reachable on WhatsApp

questions.question: Newborns discharged at 48 hours come back on day 4–5 with high bilirubin. Could parents check jaundice at home and know when to return?
questions.population: Term newborns from a private maternity hospital, first-time parents

inventions.title: Smartphone thermal imaging for pre-ulcer detection in the diabetic foot
inventions.summary: A clip-on thermal camera and app compare left and right foot temperature; a sustained asymmetry above 2.2 °C flags inflammation that precedes diabetic foot ulcer in neuropathic patients.

annot.claim: Temperature asymmetry flags pre-ulcer inflammation about a week before skin breakdown.
annot.population: Neuropathic diabetic feet, small single-centre cohort
annot.limits: Needs a standardised room temperature; not tested on darker skin tones separately.

inventions.title: Wearable bioimpedance patch for lung fluid monitoring
inventions.summary: A chest patch tracks thoracic impedance daily and alerts on pulmonary congestion trends in heart failure, aiming to flag decompensation days before readmission.

inventions.title: Calibrated under-buttock drape for measured blood loss
inventions.summary: A graduated collection drape quantifies blood loss after vaginal delivery so postpartum haemorrhage is recognised and escalated earlier than with visual estimation.

inventions.title: Fingertip camera estimate of haemoglobin
inventions.summary: A smartphone app reads fingertip colour under controlled light to estimate haemoglobin non-invasively for anaemia screening without a needle prick.

inventions.title: Low-cost fundus camera with automated retinopathy grading
inventions.summary: A handheld fundus camera with an AI grader screens for referable diabetic retinopathy in non-eye clinics.

inventions.title: Smartphone colour card for newborn bilirubin
inventions.summary: Parents photograph the baby's skin next to a printed colour card; the app estimates bilirubin and tells them when to return for neonatal jaundice review.

inventions.title: 14-day single-lead ECG patch after cryptogenic stroke
inventions.summary: An adhesive ECG patch records continuously for two weeks to detect paroxysmal atrial fibrillation after cryptogenic stroke or TIA.

inventions.title: Syringe-driven disposable negative pressure wound therapy
inventions.summary: A low-cost, power-free NPWT kit uses a spring-loaded syringe to keep negative pressure on chronic wounds such as diabetic foot ulcers and pressure injuries.

inventions.title: Nurse-led home BP titration protocol over WhatsApp
inventions.summary: Patients send home blood pressure readings twice a week; a nurse follows a stepwise antihypertensive titration algorithm and flags adherence gaps to the physician.

inventions.title: Breath sensor for early COPD exacerbation
inventions.summary: A handheld volatile-compound breath sensor aims to predict COPD exacerbation several days ahead of symptoms.

inventions.title: Phone-read urine albumin strip
inventions.summary: A urine strip read by smartphone gives an albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) at point of care to screen diabetic kidney disease.

inventions.title: Cough-sound AI triage for tuberculosis
inventions.summary: An app records cough sounds and flags people for sputum testing in tuberculosis screening camps.
